attribution.0mis_role: Narrow attributed port, source-preservation proof and bounded target-host diagnostic; not original policy authorship

build.PGO: unchanged default ./stockfish bench per side, full original pipes retained; same fixed CPU
build.compiler: same freshly resolved g++ binary+SHA/version for both; COMP=gcc COMPCXX=g++
build.target: fresh make-j2 profile-build, no cache, no prior objects/profiles

functional.embedded_net: full ELF embedded raw bytes/SHA and UCI default independently checked
functional.legality: all reported PV rows plus final bestmove/ponder legally reconstructed from exact public benchmark.cpp roots; includes2Chess960 roots; no formal positions
functional.signatures: all51 final info/PV/bestmove/ponder/per-position nodes identical between sides and every qualification/warmup/timed bench, timing/nps fields omitted only

policy.hints: READ/HIGH default prefetch on each CacheLineSize offset of the next tile; data already includes current j
policy.preserve: Current specialized fixed-address arrays, dispatch, UNROLLED_FOR and GCC unrolls, all remaining cpp bytes and all search/net sources; exact reverse-port byte proof

scope.if_fail: retain actual timing and reject this port route, do not search alternatives
scope.if_pass: send actual timings/sources to Root first; no real-clock A/B without later explicit authorization

timing.block_estimate: arithmetic mean of2A times / arithmetic mean of2B times -1, separately for both clocks
timing.cpu_affinity: lowest allowed host CPU, same for PGO and all qualification/warmup/timed native processes
timing.exclusions: no outlier removal, retries, additional blocks, adaptive reordering or alternative policy
timing.gate: median8 block speed>=0.01 on BOTH clocks AND at least7/8blocks speed>0 on BOTH clocks
timing.measurements: engine-reported benchmark elapsed_ms and Python monotonic_ns around entire fresh process (taskset wrapper included equally)
timing.stop: any functional/integrity failure withholds timing acceptance; retain all raw outputs
timing.warmup_order: AB after both fresh builds qualify
